=={{header|Ada}}==
===Version 1===
<syntaxhighlight lang="ada">
-- Rosetta Code Task written in Ada
-- Odd and square numbers
-- https://rosettacode.org/wiki/Odd_and_square_numbers
-- March 2025, R. B. E.

with Ada.Text_IO;
with Ada.Integer_Text_IO;

procedure Odd_and_Square is
  I : Positive := 3;
  I_Squared : Positive;
begin
  loop
    I_Squared := I * I;
    exit when I_Squared > 1000;
    if (I_Squared > 99) then
      Ada.Integer_Text_IO.Put (I_Squared, 4);
    end if;
    I := I + 2;
  end loop;
  Ada.Text_IO.New_Line;
end Odd_and_Square;
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
 121 169 225 289 361 441 529 625 729 841 961
</pre>
===Version 2===
<syntaxhighlight lang="ada">
-- Rosetta Code Task written in Ada
-- Odd and square numbers
-- https://rosettacode.org/wiki/Odd_and_square_numbers
-- March 2025, R. B. E.

with Ada.Text_IO;
with Ada.Integer_Text_IO;

procedure Odd_and_Square is
  I_Squared : Positive;
  Start_Squaring : constant Positive := 11;
  Stop_Squaring : constant Positive := 31;
begin
  for I in Start_Squaring..Stop_Squaring loop
    if ((I mod 2) /= 0) then    
      I_Squared := I * I;
      Ada.Integer_Text_IO.Put (I_Squared, 4);
    end if;
  end loop;
  Ada.Text_IO.New_Line;
end Odd_and_Square;
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
 121 169 225 289 361 441 529 625 729 841 961
</pre>
